enrichment.headline: Lets the Chief Business Officer sign contracts up to $50,000 a year per vendor
enrichment.summary: This changes Board Policy 3312 so the Chief Business Officer can sign contracts with a vendor on the district's behalf, up to $50,000 in total in a fiscal year. This is a limit on signing authority, not a payment to anyone. The policy change would take effect if the Board approves it.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment – Board Policy – BP 3312 Contracts and Delegation of Authority

enrichment.headline: Amends college-course agreement with Peralta Community College District for online learning
enrichment.summary: This amends the district's agreement with Peralta Community College District, which provides college pathway courses (under state law AB 288) to Oakland high school students. The changes allow online and distance learning because of the COVID-19 pandemic, name a new district representative, and reflect increases in state funding for dual enrollment and special student populations. All other terms stay the same, and no dollar amount is stated.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 1, College and Career Access Pathways Act (CCAP) Agreement - AB 288 - District and Peralta Community College District

enrichment.headline: Partners with Roses in Concrete Charter School to bring it into Howard Elementary
enrichment.summary: This is a partnership agreement (a memorandum of understanding) between the district and Roses in Concrete, a charter school, to bring the charter school into Howard Elementary School. It begins with a "Design Year" in the 2020-21 school year. No dollar amount is stated.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Memorandum of Understanding - Partnership - District and Roses in Concrete Charter School

enrichment.headline: Approves three-year labor agreement with school administrators' union, with 5% raises
enrichment.summary: This approves a tentative labor agreement between the district and United Administrators of Oakland Schools, the union for certificated and classified administrators, covering July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2022. It includes a 5% ongoing raise for current employees effective July 1, 2020, and a 5% raise effective January 1, 2020 for employees who retire on or before June 30, 2020. It also includes bonuses described in the agreement. No total dollar cost is stated.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

pulled.summary: Taken off the consent vote, then approved on a later consent report on August 1.
